title: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower in Paris was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair. It is 330 metres tall including its antennas.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level. Its elevation is 8849 metres, as measured in a 2020 survey.

title: Mount Kilimanjaro
text: Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is the highest mountain in Africa, with a summit elevation of 5895 metres.

title: Speed of light
text: The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299792458 metres per second.

title: Water
text: At sea level, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius and freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.

title: Paris
text: Paris is the capital and largest city of France. It lies on the river Seine.

title: Python (programming language)
text: Python is a programming language created by Guido van Rossum. It was first released in 1991.

title: Great Wall of China
text: A 2012 survey measured the total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China as 21196 kilometres.

title: Moon
text: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite. Its average distance from Earth is 384400 kilometres.

title: Earth
text: Earth's equatorial circumference is about 40075 kilometres. Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

title: Marathon
text: The marathon is a long-distance running race with an official distance of 42.195 kilometres.

title: Pacific Ocean
text: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceans.

title: Human skeleton
text: The adult human skeleton typically has 206 bones.

title: Mars
text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. It has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos.

title: Mona Lisa
text: The Mona Lisa is a portrait painted by Leonardo da Vinci. It hangs in the Louvre in Paris.

title: Burj Khalifa
text: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the tallest building in the world, at 828 metres.

title: Lake Baikal
text: Lake Baikal in Siberia is the deepest lake in the world, with a maximum depth of 1642 metres.

title: Statue of Liberty
text: The Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor was dedicated in 1886. It was a gift from France.

title: Apollo 11
text: Apollo 11 landed the first humans on the Moon on 20 July 1969. Neil Armstrong was the first to step onto the surface.

title: Olympic swimming pool
text: An Olympic-size swimming pool is 50 metres long and 25 metres wide.

title: Atlantis
text: Atlantis is a fictional island described by Plato in the dialogues Timaeus and Critias. There is no archaeological evidence that it existed.

title: Jupiter
text: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest planet in the Solar System.
